customManagers.description: Dockerfile `ARG *_VERSION=` pins annotated with a `# renovate: datasource=... depName=...` line directly above (homelab#1812 AC3). The dockerfile manager only reads FROM lines, so before this yq and docker-compose were never bumped. tests/test-renovate-annotations.sh fails a PR adding an unannotated *_VERSION ARG; if this regex ever stops matching, Renovate goes silent rather than erroring, so that test also checks the annotation's exact shape.

packageRules.description: Baked tool cache (homelab#1812 AC2): the fleet's setup-go/setup-python ask for '1.27' and '3.x'/'3.14', so a minor bump (go 1.28, python 3.15) would stop serving them. Patch bumps only; moving the line is a deliberate Dockerfile edit.
Baked node: the fleet asks for '24'. Minor/patch within 24 only.
Baked helm stays on 3: helm-validate-action installs 3 (get-helm-3), and baking 4 would silently change every chart render.
